takes.title: Round 1 · t1
takes.note: Same keyframe as the film's take.
takes.reading: Rests at the row end (frames 0–21), lifts, then lands about 100 px further right (frames 34–62) and lifts.
takes.prompt: Continue this exact drawing as one continuous shot: locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan, no cut, the same painted sepia style, light and framing. The old hand holds the reed stylus just above the wet clay at the right end of the row of triangular wedges. It presses the tip down once into the clay, making a small wedge just after the last one, lifts the tip a few millimetres, moves it only a tiny step to the right and presses again right beside it, so the two new wedges almost touch. Then the hand lifts the stylus a little and holds still until the end. Exactly two presses. The clay shows only plain triangular wedge impressions: no letters, no symbols, no text. The tablet, the table and the background do not move.
